items.html: Behold, the aspect of the vessels, which are the three cavities of the Galgalta, are divided into four, for the third cavity, which is the vessel for the Daat, must contain two aspects, like what is in the Mochin themselves, which are composed of Hassadim and Gevurot. And they are found to be four cavities, and they are the four Names of Elokim in the aspect of vessels, and each Elokim is 86 in gematria, which are the days of three months approximately. It is found that for the four vessels, which are the four vessels of the four Mochin, a pregnancy of twelve months was needed.
